newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Oct 2.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Prime Minister Alain Juppe calls for a "new democracy" for the year 2000 including modernisation of institutions and new forms of regional election.

-- President Jacques Chirac says wants lira to reenter ERM as soon as possible and has room to appreciate. This follows row after remark on Tuesday when Chirac voiced doubts over Italy's ability to meet the European timetable for a single currency.

-- Some firms which manufacture telecoms equipment for France Telecom object to state telecoms operator's control over their product prices, saying it has access to sensitive company information and that they want this reduced.
-- Unions at Thomson-CSF state-owned defence electronics group worried about possible job cuts linked to coming privatisation.

-- Eurotunnel EUT.PA reaches outline agreement with leading bank lenders on debt-for-equity swap. Return to balance to depend on the tunnel operator's earnings in the next few years. Shares are expected to requote next Tuesday.
